relationships.subject: SIRT1

relationships.subject: FGF21
relationships.evidence_quote: FGF21 suppressed the expression of senescence‐related markers P16, P21, and P53 in a dose‐dependent manner in TBHP‐treated NPCs

relationships.subject: SIRT1
relationships.evidence_quote: FGF21 upregulated SIRT1 and promoted the deacetylation of FOXO3 at lysine sites K241, K258, K289, and K568, thereby enhancing mitophagy and inhibiting NPCs senescence.

key_findings: FGF21 is downregulated in degenerated human and rat discs and inhibits nucleus pulposus cell senescence via SIRT1-dependent PINK1/Parkin mitophagy.
SIRT1 knockdown abolished the protective effect of FGF21 in a rat IDD model.
